title: A great game jam opportunity!
author: MD1990X
selftext:
Hey guys - I'm trying to help out in getting an AI game jam together, and with minimal "safe spaces" I guess I'm trying to make it a bit of a goal to make a bigger safe space to show off AI game design as I also work on my own project. 

If it's cool - I'd like to tell people to checkout Slap Jam - which has the goal to do just that, bring AI developers together for two days, win prizes, have fun, and most importantly - show other gamers that real people, that are passionate about game development, want to use AI.

I see this a huge team effort to get rid of the stigma that just because your programming and art skill trees aren't min/maxed - that doesn't mean we can't tell great stories, design great games, and have creative game thoughs that we otherwise wouldn't bring into the world if we didn't have this technology available to us.

Some of us are parents, entrepreneurs, and busy people that just don't have the time or bandwidth to do every single skill - but do feel in our souls, "Hey! I could design an amazing game, and I am willing to dedicate the time I do have, to bringing that to life"

[https://slapjam-ai.web.app/#jam](https://slapjam-ai.web.app/#jam)

There is prizes, if you wanna sponsor it you can, if you just wanna take part - have fun, and meet great people, I'm trying to rally this cause for my inner 7 year old that found peace in destroying my older brother at Mortal Kombat 2.

comments.author: OsrsNeedsF2P
comments.body: Why is it mobile portrait? So many AI games aren't gonna be mobile portrait

replies.author: MD1990X
replies.body: I think the intent is geared towards just scope - so that people doing it can hopefully make something cool in 2 days that other people can also just have easy access to play. A mobile inspiration tends to have simple but clever games that are feasible to make in 2 days.

comments.author: Embarrassed_Text_347
comments.body: The sponsor graphic shows $1000 to be a "platinum" sponsor. Looks like Ziva is a platinum sponsor, but the total prize pool is only $500. Where is the other $500 going?

replies.author: MD1990X
replies.body: Unsure - I'd assume costs, employing people getting it together/ hosts?
